title: Clever storage solution!
text: Clever storage solution!. I needed more storage and I also wanted something that looked nice.  I have blankets that I didn’t want to  get rid of. Construction is very sturdy and anything stored inside will stay clean.  Would be great for seasonal towels or bedding. I would defiantly buy again.

product_metadata.title: Unstuffed Ottoman Pouf Cover,Faux Fur Foot Stool, 20x12 Inches Fuzzy Chair, Round Ottoman Seat, Floor Bean Bag Chair(No Filler),Foot Rest with Storage for Living Room, Bedroom, Office White Cover ONLY
features: ⭐【Pouf Ottoman Material】--The biggest feature of this material is its amazingly soft touch, This softness comes from thousands of 1.7" plush fibers.It is soft as a plush toy.

⭐【Make Old Clothes into a Pouf Ottoman】--This Fur Pouf Ottoman comes unstuffed, it can fill in lots of blankets, sweaters, pillows, winter clothes, plush toys that makes it become an ottoman.No Filler Included.

⭐【Multi-Usage Pouf Ottoman Cover】--20x20x12 inches,After you fill this fur pouf ottoman, it could perfectly use as ottoman poufs,ottoman foot rest, foot stool, bean bag chair, extra seating, storage solution for wedding, home decor, etc.If you use it as a ottoman cover,the zipper is not large enough,you can cut down the bottom.

⭐【 Easy to Fill】--How much stuffing is needed for the ottoman?Shredded Memory Foam filler about 5 lbs, foam particle about 100L, standard size pillows about 5-6pcs,you can fill it what you want. there is no need to drive to textile recycling spots to drop off unused household soft fabric.

⭐【How to Clean】--We suggest you vacuum or wipe it. When cleaning is required, Machine washable in cold water on delicate cycle no fabric softener, air dry or a low heat dry. Simply shake the item to deal with daily dust. This pouf packed in vacuumed and shrink,please just shake it.
